title: Snake Charmer
name: Dahomet
description: A lean, theatrical easterner who keeps serpents in a box and venom in his blood. Sent by his Master to destroy the thing beneath the Estate, he carries that errand as the whole of his purpose. He arrives with his order's research and a lifetime of training aimed at the horror they call 'the Devourer', and expects no surprises.
history: The Snake Charmer was raised in a sparsely populated part of the Levantine Vizierate, taken in as a child by an order of snake charmers. The mentor he calls 'Master' corresponded with the Ancestor, who sought advice on the thing beneath the Estate. After the Ancestor's death, a summons arrived. The Master, too old and frail for the journey, trained his pupil to destroy the horror in his stead.
summary: A dutiful, patronizing Snake Charmer of a desert order, sent to destroy the horror beneath the Estate.

appearance.features: Scale patterns carved across his scalp

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: A vast striped yellow scarf wound over a bare chest
clothing.legs: Dark loincloth over a long wrapped skirt

notes: Speaks to people the way a trainer speaks to animals: patient instruction, praise, and correction
His speech sometimes slips into hisses and serpentine sounds
Finds western food tasteless and inedible, and spices everything he is given
Keeps his order's morning observance without fail, and urges others to join: a dose of venom, silent meditation, then the flute
